title: Message Action Visual QA
principle: Transcript actions must stay compact, touchable and secondary to the answer on desktop and mobile.
public_repo_rule: Visual evidence is selector, layout and copy metadata only. It contains no prompts, responses, tokens, provider keys, pairing codes, billing data or private telemetry.

expected: assistant answer remains the visual focus
copy retry save fork share-safe next-step actions wrap in one calm row
action status line is readable and secondary
message bubble uses full width without horizontal scroll
action buttons wrap into stable touch targets
safe share and next step remain visible without overlap
